intuition: Each table needs a monotonically increasing row ID and a sparse mapping of currently stored rows.

brute_force.approach: Store rows in arrays and scan each table to locate requested IDs or export rows.
brute_force.time: ins O(1), rmv/sel O(n), exp O(n)

optimal.approach: Map table names to column counts, row-ID dictionaries, and next IDs; sort live row IDs only for export.
optimal.time: ins/rmv/sel O(1) expected, exp O(r log r)

edge_cases: Removing a row does not reuse its ID.
Invalid tables, row lengths, and cells follow the specified false or <null> results.
